# Load Libraries/Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(mice)
library(NADA)
set.seed(42)

conflicted::conflict_prefer('filter', 'dplyr')
```

Using `03_cleanlab.Rda`

```{r}
# load data
load(here::here('Short Term Analysis/st_data/03_cleandata.Rda'))

# set regions variable
regions <- unique(df_mvi$Region)

# remove salinity
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  select(-Salinity)

# set analytes variable
analytes <- df_mvi %>%
  select(Chlorophyll:monreg_filt_rate) %>%
  names()
```

Note that this data does not subset for rows with phyto data; ie. this is all data with a Bloom Classification, regardless if it has corresponding phyto data or not (though, with cell density, all do).

# Unique Check

```{r}
lapply(df_mvi[sapply(df_mvi, \(x) is.character(x) || is.factor(x))], unique)
```
## Index Notes

Note: Index is numeric index, not categorical. Adding in categorical for later.


```{r}
unique(df_mvi$Index)
```

...also, is Index for SAC or SJV? Does that matter for flow variables? Confirmed there's only one index per Water Year

```{r}
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(WaterYear = if_else(as.integer(as.character(Month)) >= 10,
                             as.integer(as.character(Year)) + 1,
                             as.integer(as.character(Year))))

df_mvi %>%
  group_by(WaterYear) %>%
  summarize(n_index = n_distinct(Index, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  filter(n_index > 1)
```
Also some NAs, due to missing 2023/2024.

```{r}
df_mvi %>%
  filter(is.na(Index)) %>%
  select(Station, Year) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(Year, Station)
```

```{r}
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    Index = case_when(
      Year == 2023 ~ 8.45,
      Year == 2024 ~ 8.98,
      TRUE         ~ Index
    ),
    Index_Cat = case_when(
      is.na(Index)  ~ NA_character_,
      Index >= 9.2  ~ 'W',
      Index > 7.8  ~ 'AN',
      Index > 6.5  ~ 'BN',
      Index > 5.4  ~ 'D',
      TRUE ~ 'C'
    ),
    Index_Cat = factor(Index_Cat, levels = c('C', 'D', 'BN', 'AN', 'W'))
  )
```

# Station/Region Check

## 2015-2024

Per region, which stations have any data per event (Month+Year)?

```{r}
for (r in regions) {

  plot_df <- df_mvi %>%
    filter(Region == r) %>%
    mutate(YearMonth = as.Date(YearMonth)) %>%
    count(Station, YearMonth, name = 'n_rows') %>%
    complete(
      Station,
      YearMonth = seq.Date(
        min(YearMonth, na.rm = TRUE),
        max(YearMonth, na.rm = TRUE),
        by = 'month'
      ),
      fill = list(n_rows = 0)
    ) %>%
    mutate(row_exists = n_rows > 0)

  p <- plot_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = YearMonth, y = Station, fill = row_exists)) +
    geom_tile(color = 'blue') +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c('FALSE' = 'red', 'TRUE' = 'lightblue')
    ) +
    labs(
      title = r,
      x = NULL,
      y = 'Station',
      fill = 'Row exists'
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)
}
```



```{r}
for (r in regions) {
  first_yearmonth_tbl <- df_mvi %>%
    filter(Region == r) %>%
    mutate(YearMonth = as.Date(YearMonth)) %>%
    group_by(Station) %>%
    summarize(
      first_YearMonth = min(YearMonth, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(first_YearMonth, Station)
  
  print(first_yearmonth_tbl)
}
```

**Central**: D28A, MD10A, and P8 can be used (possibly C9, starts about 1 year later though)

**Confluence**: D26 and D19 only (D22, D16, D12 start a bit later; D24 the same time as C9; NZ068 about 6 months after that).

**Suisun Bay**: D8, D7, D6, D4 (D10 starts same time as NZ068).

### Recommendation: Start either 06/01/2016 (exclude two stations) or 05/01/2017 (include all). Only D24 should be completely removed.

TODO: check when 'summer/spring' start.

# Central Region

## Data Coverage

Note: < RL nutrient values have already been imputed and substituted (see HABvBAB_v2.Rmd)

```{r}
df_central_all <- df_mvi %>%
  filter(Region == 'Central') %>%
  filter(Station %in% c('D28A', 'MD10A', 'P8'))
```

```{r}
for (a in analytes) {
  p <- df_central_all %>%
    mutate(missing = is.na(.data[[a]])) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = YearMonth, y = Station, fill = missing)) +
      geom_tile(color = 'blue') +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c('FALSE' = 'lightblue', 'TRUE' = 'red')) +
      labs(title = paste0(a, ' - Central'),
           x = NULL, y = 'Station', fill = 'Missing') +
      theme_minimal()
  print(p)
}
```

### Conclusions

Few NA values; ones that exist are likely skipped sampling events.

Clams are missing 2024 data.

```{r}
df_mvi %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    across(all_of(analytes), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-n, names_to = 'analyte', values_to = 'n_na') %>%
  mutate(pct_na = round(100 * n_na / n, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_na))
```

```{r}
df_mvi %>%
  summarize(
    DissAmmonia = sum(DissAmmonia > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    DissNitrateNitrite = sum(DissNitrateNitrite > 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    DissOrthophos = sum(DissOrthophos > 4, na.rm = TRUE),
    DissSilica = sum(DissSilica > 40, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Remove

```{r}
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    DissAmmonia = if_else(DissAmmonia > 0.5, NA_real_, DissAmmonia),
    DissNitrateNitrite = if_else(DissNitrateNitrite > 10, NA_real_, DissNitrateNitrite),
    DissOrthophos = if_else(DissOrthophos > 4, NA_real_, DissOrthophos),
    DissSilica = if_else(DissSilica > 40, NA_real_, DissSilica)
  )
```

```{r}
df_mvi %>%
  select(
```

## Impute DON (and TKN)

Check if TKN should be used for imputation; seems like it should.

(There's one missing TKN value, so need to impute it with DON)

```{r}
ggplot(df_mvi, aes(x = TKN, y = DON)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Impute

```{r}
system_vars <- c('DON','TKN')

predictor_vars <- c(
  'Year',
  'Month',
  'Station'
)
```

```{r}
df_mice <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    Year = factor(Year),
    Month = factor(Month),
    Station = factor(Station)
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(c(predictor_vars, system_vars)))

meth <- make.method(df_mice)
meth[] <- ''
meth[system_vars] <- 'pmm'

pred <- make.predictorMatrix(df_mice)
pred[,] <- 0
pred[system_vars, c(predictor_vars, system_vars)] <- 1
diag(pred) <- 0

imp <- mice(
  df_mice,
  m = 25,
  maxit = 25,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  seed = 42,
  printFlag = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
plot(imp)
```

```{r}
densityplot(imp)
stripplot(imp, pch = 20, cex = 0.7)
```

```{r}
# pick one imputed data set
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    Year = factor(Year),
    Month = factor(Month),
    Station = factor(Station)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    complete(imp, 1) %>%
      select(Year, Month, Station, DON_imp = DON),
    by = c('Year', 'Month', 'Station')
  ) %>%
  mutate(DON = coalesce(DON, DON_imp)) %>%
  select(-DON_imp)
```

## Impute DissOrthophos/DissAmmonia/DissNitrateNitrite/DissSilica

### Impute

```{r}
system_vars <- c('DissOrthophos','DissSilica', 'DissAmmonia', 'DissNitrateNitrite')

predictor_vars <- c(
  'Year',
  'Month',
  'Station'
)
```

```{r}
df_mice <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    Year = factor(Year),
    Month = factor(Month),
    Station = factor(Station)
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(c(predictor_vars, system_vars)))

meth <- make.method(df_mice)
meth[] <- ''
meth[system_vars] <- 'pmm'

pred <- make.predictorMatrix(df_mice)
pred[,] <- 0
pred[system_vars, c(predictor_vars, system_vars)] <- 1
diag(pred) <- 0

imp <- mice(
  df_mice,
  m = 25,
  maxit = 25,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  seed = 42,
  printFlag = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
plot(imp)
```

```{r}
# too few values for accurate density plots
stripplot(imp, pch = 20, cex = 0.7)
```

```{r}
# pick one imputed data set
df_mvi <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    Year = factor(Year),
    Month = factor(Month),
    Station = factor(Station)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    complete(imp, 1) %>%
      select(Year, Month, Station, all_of(system_vars)) %>%
      rename_with(
        ~ paste0(.x, '_imp'),
        all_of(system_vars)
      ),
    by = c('Year', 'Month', 'Station')
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(system_vars),
      ~ coalesce(.x, get(paste0(cur_column(), '_imp')))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-all_of(paste0(system_vars, '_imp')))
```
